character_consistency.reason: a: all characters act per traits/motivation/flaw (Lob lies first in scn_reeve_seizure, Toll's writ outruns questions, Wenna seeks proof); b: no unsupported abilities or out-of-order knowledge (Lob's dark-wall knowledge predates story via his witness); c: ally/adversary relationships used and evolve only through shown events; d: Toll's page read back at scn_toll_reckoning and Wenna learns the page hid the parish's deed, completing both main arcs; e: both mains pursue stated goals and flaws cause complications (Wenna's proof-need stalls her, Toll's orderly lie drives the seizure)

narrative_structure.reason: (a) setup establishes Wenna, the lantern rule, missing page, and oil stakes; (b) rising scenes escalate from tithe writ to witness hunting to oil seizure and threat to her bench; (c) climax directly confronts the dark-night truth at midwinter wall test and the moot, with Wenna's decisive choice to summon council and name the cut page; (d) resolution shows Toll stripped of writ, ledger corrected, oil returned, Lob forgiven across three concrete scenes; (e) title/logline/theme match, lanterns required and present, no firearms/engines, 4 locations within limit

world_consistency.reason: (a) all scenes fit their locations and movement is explained; (b) only world locations, factions and the missing-page event are named; (c) rules upheld—one wick kept burning, ledger entry restored, no lanterns past the bog line, oil tithe called in at midwinter; (d) wardens, council and turf-cutters act per descriptions and the missing night/oil shortfall conflicts drive multiple scenes; (e) no forbidden or external elements introduced

pacing.reason: (a) all 13 scenes have distinct goals and beats; (b) rising action escalates from cut page to writ to seizure with ordered reveals; (c) act sizes 3/5/2/3, setup shorter than rising action, climax and resolution have full scenes; (d) setup scenes carry conflict, no pure exposition; (e) three aftermath scenes settle toll's reckoning, oil return and final lighting
